assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original unbranded fashion editorial photography for a clothing website, NOT a website mockup. Create a wide triptych of three separate full-height studio fashion portraits with clean straight vertical divisions and no margins. Left third: adult woman with short dark bob wearing an oversized black blazer, white crew neck T-shirt and wide black trousers, relaxed standing pose, framed head to mid calf. Center third: adult male fashion model with cropped hair in a loose ivory cotton T-shirt and tailored charcoal wide-leg trousers, leaning slightly, hands in pockets, framed head to mid calf. Right third: adult woman with tied-back hair in a crisp white oversized shirt and flowing black skirt, elegant walking pose, framed head to ankles. Neutral light gray seamless studio backdrop in each panel, subtle floor shadows, tactile fabric details, natural skin texture, directional soft light, refined independent fashion magazine photography, silver-gelatin black and white, realistic human anatomy. Entire image monochrome. No text, logos, labels, watermarks, borders, UI, props, accessories, or decorative graphics. Portraits fill their own thirds so each can be cropped independently as an editorial card.
